description: This Dart source file defines the AttendanceRepository class, which provides high-level attendance data operations, including marking attendance, fetching daily and weekly attendance, and synchronizing pending offline actions with a remote server. It interacts with various data sources and network endpoints to manage attendance data in an offline-first application.

classes.name: AttendanceRepository
classes.description: Provides methods to mark attendance, retrieve attendance data for specific days or weeks, and synchronize pending offline data with a remote server.

methods.name: markNow
methods.description: Marks attendance at the current moment with a specified status; optionally includes notes.

methods.name: getDaily
methods.description: Fetches daily attendance records for a given date.

methods.name: getWeekly
methods.description: Fetches weekly attendance records starting from a specific week start date.

methods.name: syncPending
methods.description: Synchronizes all pending offline attendance events with the remote server; on success clears the pending queue.
